g.text: OPTION A — SOFA CENTERED ON THE FRONT NOOK
OPTION B — SOFA ON THE BATH 2 WALL BY THE ENTRY

svg.text: NOOK ≈ 7'-0½" W x 2'-3" D. AN 86" SOFA IS ~1½" TOO WIDE TO SLIDE INTO IT (82" OR LESS FITS).
SIZES: KING BED 80" x 86" (76" x 80" MATTRESS) · NIGHTSTANDS 22" x 16" · TV CONSOLE 84" x 18" · SOFA 86" x 38" DEEP (ASSUMED)
